title: Great value, perfect alternative to compressed air.
text: Great value, perfect alternative to compressed air.. I use this to clean all parts of my gaming pc. It sucks that dirt right out of all the nooks and crannies. works well for the keyboard, and cooling fans. I even use it to clean the dirt out of my liquid cooling system radiators. We live in a dusty area so I clean about once a week and it keeps everything top notch. And it doesn't blow all the dust into the air like a can of compressed air does.
